title: Austin's November Election & Bonds
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   The entire special meeting was dedicated to planning for the upcoming November 2012 election.
*   A major focus was to formally approve the specific general obligation bonds that would be presented to voters, which are critical for funding future city projects.
*   Discussions also involved legal counsel and city staff to ensure all election and bond-related matters were handled appropriately and legally.
transcript:
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING 
 
Friday, August 17, 2012 
The Austin City Council will convene at 2:00 PM on 
Friday, August 17, 2012 at Austin City Hall 
301 W. Second Street, Austin, TX 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Mayor Lee Leffingwell 
Mayor Pro Tem Sheryl Cole 
Council Member Chris Riley, Place 1 
Council Member Mike Martinez, Place 2 
Council Member Kathie Tovo, Place 3 
Council Member Laura Morrison, Place 4 
Council Member William Spelman, Place 5 
 
 
 
 
For meeting information, contact the City Clerk, 974-2210 
 
 
The City Council will go into a closed session under Chapter 551 of the Texas Government Code 
to receive advice from legal counsel, to discuss matters of land acquisition, to discuss personnel matters, 
to discuss or take action on a “competitive matter” of Austin Energy as provided for 
under Section 551.086, or for other reasons permitted by law as specifically listed on this agenda. 
If necessary, the City Council may go into a closed session as permitted by law regarding any item on this agenda.  
 
All of the following items may be acted upon by one motion. No separate discussion or 
action on any of the items is necessary unless desired by a Council Member. 
 
 
 
 
Law 
 
1. 
Approve an ordinance amending the order calling the November 6, 2012 Special 
Election to provide for general obligation bond propositions, and declaring an 
emergency. 
 
2. 
Discussion of November 2012 election matters and potential direction to staff. 
 
 
 
Executive Session 
 
3. 
Discuss legal issues relating to the November 6, 2012 election (Private 
consultation with legal counsel pursuant to Section 551.071 of the Government 
Code). 
 
Adjourn
